21657-deep-furrows.description: A book by Hopkins Moorhouse. bserved, so lost in the immensity of landscape that it appeared to be stationary. It was well out upon the trail that wound northward from Indian Head into the country of the Fishing Lakes--the trail that forked also eastward to dip through the valley of the Qu'Appelle at Blackwood before striking north and east across the Kenlis plain towards the Pheasant Hills.

arxiv-2201-01047.title: DIAL: Deep Interactive and Active Learning for Semantic Segmentation in Remote Sensing
arxiv-2201-01047.creator: Gaston Lenczner, Adrien Chan-Hon-Tong, Bertrand Le Saux, Nicola Luminari, and Guy Le Besnerais
arxiv-2201-01047.description: Abstract We propose in this article to build up a collaboration between a deep neural network and a human in the loop to swiftly obtain accurate segmentation maps of remote sensing images. In a nutshell, the agent iteratively interacts with the network to correct its initially flawed predictions. Concretely, these interactions are annotations representing the semantic labels.

arxiv-2203-08763.title: Orion A’s complete 3D magnetic field morphology
arxiv-2203-08763.creator: M. Tahani, J. Glover, W. Lupypciw, J.L. West, R. Kothes, R. Plume, S. Inutsuka, M-Y. Lee, I.A. Grenier, L.B.G. Knee, J.C. Brown, Y. Doi, T. Robishaw, M. Haverkorn
arxiv-2203-08763.description: Abstract Magnetic fields permeate the interstellar medium and are important in the star formation process. Determining the 3D magnetic fields of molecular clouds will allow us to better understand their role in the evolution of these clouds and formation of stars.

arxiv-2209-01380.title: Classification of Breast Tumours Based on Histopathology Images Using Deep Features and Ensemble of Gradient Boosting Methods
arxiv-2209-01380.creator: Mohammad Reza Abbasniya {}^{\lx@orcidlink{0000-0003-0806-2858}{\orcidlogo}}~, Sayed Ali Sheikholeslamzadeh {}^{\lx@orcidlink{0000-0001-6898-813X}{\orcidlogo}}~, Hamid Nasiri {}^{\lx@orcidlink{0000-0002-9279-6063}{\orcidlogo}}~, Samaneh Emami {}^{\lx@orcidlink{0000-0002-3879-7188}{\orcidlogo}}~
arxiv-2209-01380.description: Abstract Breast cancer is the most common cancer among women worldwide. Early-stage diagnosis of breast cancer can significantly improve the efficiency of treatment. Computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems are widely adopted in this issue due to their reliability, accuracy and affordability.

arxiv-2307-01325.title: Robust Uncertainty Estimation for Classification of Maritime Objects
arxiv-2307-01325.creator: Jonathan Becktor, Frederik Schöller, Evangelos Boukas, Lazaros Nalpantidis
arxiv-2307-01325.description: Abstract We explore the use of uncertainty estimation in the maritime domain, showing the efficacy on toy datasets (CIFAR10) and proving it on an in-house dataset, SHIPS. We present a method joining the intra-class uncertainty achieved using Monte Carlo Dropout, with recent discoveries in the field of outlier detection, to gain more holistic uncertainty measures.

arxiv-2509-19265.title: Cross-Cultural Transfer of Commonsense Reasoning in LLMs: Evidence from the Arab World
arxiv-2509-19265.creator: Saeed Almheiri, Rania Hossam, Mena Attia, Chenxi Wang, Timothy Baldwin, Fajri Koto
arxiv-2509-19265.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) often reflect Western-centric biases, limiting their effectiveness in diverse cultural contexts. Although some work has explored cultural alignment, the potential for cross-cultural transfer, using alignment in one culture to improve performance in others, remains underexplored.

pmc-10704590.title: Sulfuric Acid Catalyzed Esterification of Amino Acids in Thin Film
pmc-10704590.creator: Chiara Salvitti, Giulia de Petris, Anna Troiani, Marta Managò, Alessia Di Noi, Andreina Ricci, Federico Pepi
pmc-10704590.description: The esterification reaction of different amino acids with methanol catalyzed by H2SO4 was first studied in the small volume of thin films generated by ESI microdroplet deposition. The reaction is promoted by the pneumatic spray of the ESI source and reaches its maximum efficiency at a thin film temperature of 70 °C. Selective esterification of the COOH moiety was demonstrated.

pmc-10724026.title: GAABind: a geometry-aware attention-based network for accurate protein–ligand binding pose and binding affinity prediction
pmc-10724026.creator: Huishuang Tan, Zhixin Wang, Guang Hu
pmc-10724026.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Protein–ligand interactions are increasingly profiled at high-throughput, playing a vital role in lead compound discovery and drug optimization. Accurate prediction of binding pose and binding affinity constitutes a pivotal challenge in advancing our computational understanding of protein–ligand interactions. However, inherent limitations still exist, including high computational cost for conformational search sampling in traditional molecular docking tools, and the unsatisfactory molecular representation learning and intermolecular interaction modeling in deep learning-based methods.

pmc-11586436.title: usfAD based effective unknown attack detection focused IDS framework
pmc-11586436.creator: Md Ashraf Uddin, Sunil Aryal, Mohamed Reda Bouadjenek, Muna Al-Hawawreh, Md Alamin Talukder
pmc-11586436.description: The rapid expansion of varied network systems, including the Internet of Things (IoT) and the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), has led to an increasing range of cyber threats. Ensuring robust protection against these threats necessitates the implementation of an effective Intrusion Detection System (IDS).

pmc-12506022.title: Exploring academic motivation across university years: a mixed-methods study at King Faisal University
pmc-12506022.creator: Mazen Omar Almulla, Abdulaziz Mohammed Alismail, Heba Daraghmeh
pmc-12506022.description: This study explores how gender and year of study influence academic motivation among undergraduate students at King Faisal University, Saudi Arabia, an understudied non-Western, gender-segregated context in the motivation literature. By situating the research within this unique population, the study responds to calls for expanding motivational research beyond Western samples and contributes culturally grounded insights to the field.

pmc-12568079.title: Burg-Aided 2D MIMO Array Extrapolation for Improved Spatial Resolution
pmc-12568079.creator: Muge Bekar, Ali Bekar, Anum Pirkani, Christopher John Baker, Marina Gashinova
pmc-12568079.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). In this paper, the extrapolation of a 2D multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) array is proposed using the Burg algorithm to achieve higher angular resolution beyond that of the corresponding 2D MIMO virtual array. The main advantage of such an approach is that it allows us to dramatically decrease both the physical size and the number of antenna elements of the MIMO array. The performance and limitations of the Burg algorithm are examined through both simulation and experimentation at 77 GHz.

pmc-12591044.title: Exposure to protracted low-dose ionizing radiation and incident dementia in a cohort of Ontario nuclear power plant workers
pmc-12591044.creator: Brianna Frangione, Ian Colman, Franco Momoli, Estelle Davesne, Robert Talarico, Chengchun Yu, Paul J Villeneuve
pmc-12591044.description: ObjectivesEmerging evidence suggests that low-dose ionizing radiation increases the risk of neurodegenerative diseases. Past studies have relied on death data to identify dementia, and these are prone to under-ascertainment and complicate the estimation of health risks as individuals tend to live with dementia for many years following onset.

pmc-12683433.title: Features associated with 90-day in-person follow-up care after virtual visits in urology
pmc-12683433.creator: Eric Qualkenbush, Sydney Bluestein, Amanda Kahn, Neda Qosja, Alex Hochwald, Ram A Pathak, Chandler D Dora, Andrew J Zganjar, David D Thiel, Timothy D Lyon
pmc-12683433.description: BackgroundThe coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic created a paradigm shift in healthcare delivery with rapid utilization of telehealth in urology. Despite cessation of pandemic policies, urologists continue to utilize telehealth at a high rate. While these visits can improve access and convenience for many, the degree to which they translate to in person encounters remains underexplored.

pmc-12722794.title: The cerebellar-related cognitive function is sensitive to aging: implications for early detection
pmc-12722794.creator: Qianying Ma, Min Pu, Meijia Li, Ling Liu, Ruilin Wu
pmc-12722794.description: BackgroundAccumulating evidence demonstrated that the cerebellum contributes to a wide range of sensorimotor and cognitive functions. However, the relationship between cerebellar function and cognitive abilities in normal aging populations remains unclear.MethodsThe present cross-sectional study tested cerebellar-related cognitive changes across middle to late adulthood using the Cerebellar Cognitive Affective Syndrome (CCAS) scale and a perceptual serial reaction time (SRT) task.

pmc-12749021.title: Functional morphology of the leg musculature in the marine seal louse: adaptations for high-performance attachment to diving hosts
pmc-12749021.creator: Anika Preuss, Thomas van de Kamp, Elias Hamann, Marcus Zuber, Lina Ornowski, Stanislav N. Gorb
pmc-12749021.description: The seal louse (Echinophthirius horridus) is a remarkable example of evolutionary adaptation, thriving as an obligate ectoparasite on deep-diving marine mammals under extreme environmental conditions, including high hydrostatic pressure, extreme drag force, salinity, and fluctuating temperatures. To investigate the anatomical and functional specializations enabling this lifestyle, we compared the leg morphology and musculature of E.

pmc-13082745.title: Long versus short cephalomedullary femoral nail for treatment of unstable intertrochanteric fractures: A single-blinded randomized controlled study
pmc-13082745.creator: Abdelrahman Amir AbouelEla, Haytham Abdel-Azim, Ahmed Sayed Kotb
pmc-13082745.description: Background: ITF are extracapsular proximal femoral fractures that occur in both younger and older populations, with a higher prevalence among females. They account for most hip fractures, reaching 44.1%. The Elderly are at risk with an increased first-year mortality risk reaching up to 30%.

pmc-13291710.title: Hannes Hagström 1981–2026
pmc-13291710.creator: Jonas F Ludvigsson
pmc-13291710.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The manuscript he had started writing at that time was about ‘fatty liver’ and pregnancy. In total, he would write almost 300 articles. Hannes Hagström's career was going at record speed. He defended his thesis in 2016 and then did a postdoc at the clinical research unit ‘KEP’ at Karolinska Institutet before he established his own research group at south Karolinska University Hospital Huddinge. pmc-13466659.title: Adjuvant multimodality immunotherapy in resected high-risk pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
pmc-13466659.creator: Arunkumar Krishnan, Diptasree Mukherjee
pmc-13466659.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). th resectable disease, the only population for whom a cure is possible, and even in this group, recurrence after surgery is nearly universal without effective adjuvant therapy. Five-year OS after resection remains in the 10–20% range (2,3). Modified FOLFIRINOX (mFFX) in the adjuvant setting, validated by the PRODIGE 24 trial, represented meaningful progress, but most resected patients still recur, with a median disease-free survival (DFS) of around 21 months (4).
